data.narrative:
Texture Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Sanjiv Sanghavi, Victor Quinn, and Nicholas Brown that has raised $24.3M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix, though none of these align closely enough on stage, timing, or valuation tier to support a robust peer-median benchmark.

Given data limitations, the valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage advancement to the $24.3M total raised proxy. This method yields an implied valuation of $48.6M. The single applicable method constrains analytical robustness; a sensitivity band of $41M (low) to $56M (high) reflects reasonable variance around this central estimate, with $48.6M serving as the median point.

The $41M–$56M range is defensible given company stage and capital deployed, but hinges on two material uncertainties: the absence of directly comparable Series A peers limits validation of the 2.0x multiplier for this specific subsector, and the undisclosed current valuation leaves no ground truth for calibration. Additional data on recent Climate & Energy Series A outcomes or clearer definition of Texture Energy's technical or commercial differentiation would strengthen conviction in this range.
